findings.F1: SPEC_BY_GROUP is NOT exported from scripts/qc/gm-two-player-campaign-core.cjs. It is a const declared INSIDE buildRunPlan (line 51), together with the AUTHORITY_GROUP_MEMBERS and ALL_GROUP_MEMBERS expansions. U9's behavior sentence in units.json says the contract 'reads the milestone-to-group ladder from SPEC_BY_GROUP'; it cannot, and the charter forbids modifying the core module. The contract therefore names the three milestone groups by their REGISTERED_GROUPS names and never lists specs, so the evolving smoke subset still grows only in buildRunPlan. Reported, not fixed: exporting SPEC_BY_GROUP is a core-module change this unit does not own.
findings.F2: The default archive dir .sisyphus/roadmap-completion-20260912/exact-main-ladder is gitignored (git check-ignore -v prints '.gitignore:189:.sisyphus/*'). An archive receipt written there is local-only and never reaches main. The CLI therefore reads BOTH the evidence dir and the archive dir, so a receipt the loop copies into the tracked evidence dir (DELIVERY.md's log-preservation rule) counts as coverage. Enforcing that copy is the loop's job, not this contract's.
findings.F3: No main-proof receipt in the ledger has ever run the smoke, fixture-smoke or membership-smoke group, so E2E-80's staged subset has never actually been rerun against an exact main commit. The contract makes that visible; it does not fix it.

risksForTheParent: Enforcement is procedural, exactly as PK-e2e-80-ci-wiring decided: nothing runs this contract automatically. If the loop does not call 'npm run qc:exact-main-ladder' before the next dependent PR, E2E-80's 'SHALL rerun before the next dependent PR' is unenforced. The packet's own consequence text says so.

The contract reads MISSING at every commit in the ledger today (finding F3). The first SATISFIED reading needs a main proof that runs --group=smoke; if the parent wants U9's own main proof to be that reading, it must add the smoke run to the proof, which costs a real Playwright run.

Coverage is by receipt text, not by re-execution. A receipt whose runtime.playwright line was mistyped counts (or fails to count) on its spelling alone. The contract fails closed - anything unparseable yields no groups - but it cannot detect a receipt that reports a run that did not happen.
--rerun is never exercised against the real Playwright ladder in this lane (charter: jest only, no Playwright run). The parent's main proof is the first real exercise of that branch.
